The source checks a successful readonly server initialization and declares caller Authorization was not forwarded; this review did not execute those checks. The complete blob length, SHA256, Git blob SHA1 and every cited context line were independently verified by root. This decision admits this exact fixture source only and does not qualify execution behavior.

The hit is a fixed deliberately irrelevant caller Authorization value passed to the installed bridge initialization. The assertion label requires the readonly server to accept initialization while ignoring caller Authorization. The source report declares caller_authorization_forwarded false. No backend credential value is embedded in this blob. The complete blob length, SHA256, Git blob SHA1 and every cited context line were independently verified by root. This decision admits this exact fixture source only and does not qualify execution behavior.

The hit is a hard-coded wrong token in a table whose expected HTTP status is 401. The task-owned daemon token is separately generated at runtime with secrets.token_hex(32), stored in a private temporary token file, and used by normal requests. Thus the matched constant is an intentionally invalid authentication control, not the generated credential. No test or daemon was executed by this review. The complete blob length, SHA256, Git blob SHA1 and every cited context line were independently verified by root. This decision admits this exact fixture source only and does not qualify execution behavior.

The credential_json_value hit is the token key of a mocked prepare_text return object. The same fixed literal is checked as a PreparedPlan handle. keyboard._request is replaced by the local fake function and the test asserts keyboard.proc is None. This is an opaque fake plan identifier, not an access token, password, or private key. The complete blob length, SHA256, Git blob SHA1 and every cited context line were independently verified by root. This decision admits this exact fixture source only and does not qualify execution behavior.

The complete blob length, SHA256, Git blob SHA1 and every cited context line were independently verified by root. This decision admits this exact fixture source only and does not qualify execution behavior.
